results.test_desc: Ensure that the --cert-file and --key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
results.remediation: Follow the etcd service documentation and configure TLS encryption.

results.test_desc: Ensure that the --client-cert-auth argument is set to true (Automated)
results.remediation: Edit the etcd pod specification file and set --client-cert-auth="true".

results.test_desc: Ensure that a unique Certificate Authority is used for etcd (Manual)
results.remediation: Follow the etcd documentation and create a dedicated certificate authority setup for the etcd service.
